title: Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful North African stew made with tender lamb and fragrant spices, typically cooked in a clay pot with a conical lid.

ingredients.name: Dark Algerian tagine spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at Middle Eastern or North African markets

instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the tagine spice mix, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the prunes and 1 cup of water. Bring to a simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
Let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving.
